svg.title: The map of all cases
svg.desc: Each case is a dot. Across: the AI's share of the device's power. Up: three ordered bands, not a number. Money would move, and we can't yet tell if analog reaches the gain: P27 at 1.3%, P17 at 4.9%, P25 at 5.6%, P23 at 12%, P02 at 13%, P12 at 24%, P16 at 33%, P13 at 35%. Money would move, but analog can't reach the gain needed: P04 at 4.8%, P28 at 13%, P10 at 22%, P09 at 26%, P05 at 64%. No money moves when the AI uses less power or time: P18 at 1.2%, P19 at 2.2%, P26 at 5.4%, P20 at 6.2%, P01 at 8.1%, P15 at 8.8%, P21 at 10%, P24 at 13%, P11 at 14%, P03 at 22%, P29 at 26%, P06 at 29%, P14 at 44%. Can't place: P07, P08, P22, P30.
